# Architect Challenge Verdict - Radar Reevaluation and Adoption Audit
resource: .github/harness/memory/briefs/radar-reevaluation-and-adoption-audit-2026-07-26.md

VERDICT: APPROVED

## Evidence

- Ownership and boundaries are explicit, with scope constrained to reevaluation artifacts and decision-log updates.
- Integration classifications now have objective criteria (`integrated`, `partially integrated`, `not integrated`).
- Promotion from parked/rejected now requires an explicit checklist with prerequisite and evidence requirements.
- Matrix evidence requirements are explicit, making decisions auditable and reproducible.

Implement the reevaluation matrix and append decision-log updates to entries whose status or integration verdict changes.
